name: dimethicone 20 + petrolatum
uses: Uses Helps prevent, temporarily protects and helps relieve chafed, chapped or cracked skin Helps prevent and protect from the drying effects of wind and cold weather Temporarily protects minor cuts scrapes burns For External Use Only Apply as needed
otcwarn: For external use only Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away Do not use on deep or puncture wounds animal bites serious burns When using this product do not get into eyes Stop use and ask doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
